Rashi on Ketubot 17b:10:1.hebrew: ורב הונא מתניתין אתא לאשמועינן - בתמיה. כיון דמתניתין בהכי עסקינן ולא מיתוקמא אלא בהכי, מאי אתא רב הונא לאשמועינן? הרי כבר שנויה ועומדת, ודבר השנוי במשנתינו שגור בפי הכל:
Rashi on Ketubot 17b:10:1.english: And [did] Rav Huna come to teach us a Mishnah - [This is asked] in astonishment. Since [in] our Mishnah we are dealing with this [case] and it cannot be established except in this [way], what did Rav Huna come to teach us? Behold, it is already taught and standing, and anything taught in our Mishnah is fluent in everyone's mouth.

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:10:2.hebrew: דיוקא דמתניתין אתא לאשמועינן - משום דמתני' לא מיפרשא בהדיא דבהכי עסקינן, ואתא רב הונא לאשמועינן בהדיא, ומדיוקא דמתני' קא יליף לה:
Rashi on Ketubot 17b:10:2.english: He came to teach us the inference of the Mishnah - Because the Mishnah does not state explicitly that we are dealing with this [case], and Rav Huna came to teach us [this] explicitly, and he derives it from the inference of the Mishnah.

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:11:1.hebrew: וליתנייה בדידיה - שדה זו שלך היתה, אם יש עדים כו' אינו נאמן, ואע"ג שאכלה שני חזקה, וכגון שהיו שתים בפניו ואחת שלא בפניו:
Rashi on Ketubot 17b:11:1.english: And let [the tanna] teach it regarding [the claimant] himself - "This field was yours..." — if there are witnesses, etc., he is not believed, even though he consumed [its produce for] the years of presumptive ownership, and [this is] where two [years] were in his presence and one was not in his presence.

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:11:2.english: Where he fled - And [the Tanna] teaches us that that year does not count for him.

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:12:1.hebrew: אי ברח מחמת ממון - שאינו ירא מן המלכות, אלא מצעקת הצועקים בעיר:
Rashi on Ketubot 17b:12:1.english: If he fled due to money - [Meaning] that he does not fear the government, but rather the outcry of those crying out [against him] in the city.

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:12:2.hebrew: איבעי ליה למחויי - במקום שהוא שם, וכיון דלא מיחה, חזקה מעלייתא היא:
Rashi on Ketubot 17b:12:2.english: He ought to have protested - in the place where he is; and since he did not protest, it is a valid presumptive ownership.

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:13:1.hebrew: שלש ארצות לחזקה - שלש ארצות של א"י חשובות חלוקות זו מזו לענין חזקה, כאילו הן ארצות נכריות. ואם היה בזו והחזיק אחר בקרקע שיש לו בחברתה, אינה חזקה:
Rashi on Ketubot 17b:13:1.english: Three lands with regard to presumptive ownership - Three regions of the Land of Israel are considered distinct from one another with respect to presumptive ownership, as though they were foreign lands. And if [the owner] was in one [region] and another [person] took possession of land that he has in the other [region], it is not [valid] presumptive ownership.

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:13:2.hebrew: במדינה - או שניהם בגליל, או שניהם ביהודה, ואפי' הן בשתי עיירות:
Rashi on Ketubot 17b:13:2.english: In [the same] country - Either both of them [are] in the Galilee or both of them [are] in Judea, and even [if] they are in two [different] cities.

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:14:1.hebrew: ואי קסבר מחאה שלא בפניו לא הויא מחאה - כגון אם היה בעיר אחת, ומיחה שלא בפניו בפני שנים בעיר אחרת:
Rashi on Ketubot 17b:14:1.english: And if he holds that a protest [lodged] not in his presence is not a [valid] protest - For example, if [the occupant] was in one city, and [the owner] protested not in his presence before two [witnesses] in another city.

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:14:2.hebrew: אפי' יהודה וגליל נמי - הוה ליה למחויי היכא דהוי, ומדלא מחי תיהוי חזקה:
Rashi on Ketubot 17b:14:2.english: Even [in] Judea and [the] Galilee as well - He should have protested wherever he was, and since he did not protest, it should be a chazakah [presumptive ownership].

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:14:3.hebrew: אפילו יהודה ויהודה - בשתי עיירות נמי לא תיהוי חזקה, דלא הוה ליה למחויי שלא בפניו:
Rashi on Ketubot 17b:14:3.english: Even [in the case of] Judea and Judea - [When they are] in two [different] towns, it should also not become a chazakah [presumptive ownership], since he could not protest not in his presence.

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:15:1.hebrew: הויא מחאה - דחברך חברא אית ליה, דהני דמחי באנפייהו מגלו לאחריני, ובא הדבר לאזני המחזיק, וה"ל לאזדהורי בשטריה:
Rashi on Ketubot 17b:15:1.english: Is a protest - Because your friend has a friend, for those in whose presence he protested reveal [it] to others, and the matter comes to the ears of the occupier, and he should have been careful with his deed.

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:15:2.english: And our Mishnah - which teaches: "[Between] Judea and Galilee, [there is] no [presumptive ownership]."

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:15:3.hebrew: בשעת חירום שנו - דיכול לומר, לא נגלית לי מחאתו, שאשמור את שטרי:
Rashi on Ketubot 17b:15:3.english: [The Sages] taught [this Mishnah] with regard to a time of crisis - For [the occupier] can say, "His protest was not revealed to me so that I would safeguard my deed."

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:16:1.hebrew: ומאי שנא יהודה וגליל דנקט - אם יש חירום נמי מעיר לעיר, אפי' שתי עיירות באותה מדינה נמי לא:
Rashi on Ketubot 17b:16:1.english: And what is different [about] Judea and Galilee that [the Tanna] cited - If there is an emergency from city to city as well, even [between] two towns in the same province [it is] also not [effective].

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:1:1.english: However, for one who taught - others.

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:1:2.hebrew: לית ליה שיעורא - וממילא שמעינן דלמאן דלא קרי ולא תני, אין מבטלין אם יש לו מתעסקין כדי קבורה בעלמא. בשאלתות דרב אחאי מצאתי כן:
Rashi on Ketubot 17b:1:2.english: There is no measure for him - And by implication we learn that for one who neither reads [Scripture] nor studies [Mishnah], we do not interrupt [Torah study] if he has [people] attending to him merely enough for burial. In the She'iltot of Rav Achai I found [it] thus.

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:2:1.english: A canopy of myrtle - Like a kind of round canopy of myrtle.

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:2:2.hebrew: קריתא - צעיף על ראשה משורבב על עיניה, כמו שעושין במקומינו. ופעמים שמנמנמת בתוכו מתוך שאין עיניה מגולין, ולכך נקרא הינומא על שם תנומה:
Rashi on Ketubot 17b:2:2.english: Kerita - A veil on her head hanging down over her eyes, as they do in our region. And sometimes she dozes inside it since her eyes are not uncovered, and therefore it is called hinnuma, after [the word] tenumah [slumber].

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:3:1.hebrew: ביהודה ראיה - כל הני דמתני', ששם היו רגילין בסימנין הללו לבתולה:
Rashi on Ketubot 17b:3:1.english: In Judea, [that is] proof - All these [things mentioned] in the Mishnah, for there they were accustomed to these signs for a virgin.

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:3:2.english: Smearing oil - The women put oil on the heads of the scholars and rub [it in].

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:3:3.hebrew: מישחא דחפיפותא - [שמן של בשמים שמתוקן לחופות] קאמר מר? וכי בעלי חפיפות הן לסוכן שמן:
Rashi on Ketubot 17b:3:3.english: Oil of chafifuta - [Spiced oil that is prepared for wedding canopies] is what the Master is saying? Are [the Sages] people who wash [their hair] to anoint them with oil?

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:3:4.english: Orphan - An orphan from the prevailing custom.

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:3:5.english: He arranged for his son - To marry a wife for him.

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:3:6.english: And he smeared oil - He rubbed oil on the head of the students.

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:4:1.english: What [about] a widow - What signs do they make for a widow to make known that a widow is being married?

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:4:2.hebrew: לית לה כיסני - אין לה קליות, וזה סימנה:
Rashi on Ketubot 17b:4:2.english: She does not have kisanei - She does not have roasted grain, and this is her sign.

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:5:1.hebrew: וליתני מודה ר' יהושע כו' שדה זו שלך היתה - כיון דטעמא משום דאין שור שחוט לפניו הוא, שלא היה אדם תובעו, מה לי של אביו ומה לי שלו? ומאי שנא של אביך דנקט:
Rashi on Ketubot 17b:5:1.english: And let [the Mishnah] teach: Rabbi Yehoshua concedes, etc., "This field belonged to you" - Since the reason [he is believed] is because there is no "slaughtered ox before him" — [meaning] that no one was suing him — what difference is there [whether it was] his father's and what difference is there [whether it was] his? And why specifically did [the Mishnah] state "your father's"?

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:7:1.hebrew: שני חזקה - שלש שנים שתיקנו חכמים לכל מחזיקים בקרקע, דמשאכלה שלש שנים בלא עירעור, נאמן לומר לקחתיה ואבד שטרי, דכולי האי לא מזדהר איניש בשטרא:
Rashi on Ketubot 17b:7:1.english: Years of presumptive ownership - [This refers to the] three years that the Sages instituted for all [who] take possession of land; for once he has consumed [its produce for] three years without protest, he is believed to say, "I purchased it and my deed was lost," because for so long [a time] a person is not careful [to preserve] a deed.

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:9:1.hebrew: בשלמא גבי אביו משכחת לה - דאיצטריך למיתנייה, כגון דאכלה שני חזקה, ואפילו הכי לא מהימן; וכגון שאכלה שתי שנים ראשונות בחיי אביו, ומת, ואכלה השלישית לפני הבן הזה, והוא היה קטן ולא עירער. ואיצטריך לאשמועינן, דכיון דקטן היה, אין השנה הזאת עולה מן המנין:
Rashi on Ketubot 17b:9:1.english: Granted, with regard to his father, you find it - that it was necessary to teach it, [such as in a case] where he consumed [the produce of the field for] the years of presumptive ownership, and even so he is not believed; namely, where he consumed [it for] the first two years during his father's lifetime, and [the father] died, and he consumed [it for] the third [year] before this son, and [the son] was a minor and did not protest. And it was necessary to teach us that since he was a minor, this year does not count toward the tally.

Rashi on Ketubot 17b:9:2.hebrew: וכדרב הונא דאמר אין מחזיקין בנכסי קטן - המחזיק בנכסי קטן שלש שנים, אינה חזקה; דהאי דלא מיחה, משום דקטן הוא. ואפילו הגדיל לאחר מיכן והחזיק זה בפניו כמה שנים, אינה חזקה; הואיל ותחלתו כשהוא קטן ראהו מוחזק בה, לא ידע כשהגדיל שהיתה של אביו, עד ששומע מפי אחרים:
Rashi on Ketubot 17b:9:2.english: And in accordance with Rav Huna, who said: One cannot establish presumptive ownership of the property of a minor - One who holds possession of a minor's property [for] three years, it is not [a valid] presumptive ownership, for the reason that [the minor] did not protest is because he is a minor. And even if he reached majority afterward and this [person] held possession [of it] in his presence [for] several years, it is not [a valid] presumptive ownership; since at the outset, when he was a minor, he saw him in possession of it, he did not know when he reached majority that it had belonged to his father until he hears [so] from others.

Tosafot on Ketubot 17b:10:1.hebrew: ורב הונא מתני' אתא לאשמועינן - לאו דווקא נקט רב הונא, דהא לא איירי רב הונא התם אלא במורידין קרוב לנכסי קטן, והא לא שמעינן ממתני'; אלא כלומר: רבא — דדייק התם "ש"מ מדרב הונא דאין מחזיקין בנכסי קטן" — מאי אתא לאשמועינן:
Tosafot on Ketubot 17b:10:1.english: "And did Rav Huna come to teach us a Mishnah?" - [The Gemara] did not mention Rav Huna precisely, for Rav Huna was only speaking there about [whether] we install a relative into the property of a minor, and we do not learn that from [our] Mishnah. Rather, it means to say: Rava — who inferred there, "Learn from [this statement of] Rav Huna that one cannot establish presumptive ownership of a minor's property" — what did he come to teach us?

Tosafot on Ketubot 17b:12:1.hebrew: מחאה שלא בפניו כו' - תימה, אמאי נקט בכל דוכתא "מחאה שלא בפניו"? הוה ליה למינקט "חזקה שלא בפניו" כו'! וי"ל, דעיקר הטע' תלוי במחאה: דחזקה ודאי יש לה קול אפי' שלא בפניו, ואפ"ה אי מחאה אין לה קול — לא הוי חזקה; ולהכי נקט מחא':
Tosafot on Ketubot 17b:12:1.english: A protest not in his presence, etc. - It is puzzling: why does [the Gemara] everywhere state "a protest not in his presence"? It should have stated "presumptive ownership not in his presence," etc.! And one can answer that the main reason depends on the protest: for presumptive ownership certainly becomes widely known even [when established] not in his presence, and even so, if a protest does not become widely known, it is not presumptive ownership; and therefore it states "protest":

Tosafot on Ketubot 17b:1:1.hebrew: אבל מאן דמתני לית ליה שיעורא - בשאלתות דרב אחאי כתוב: וממילא שמעינן למאן דלא קרי ולא תני, אין מבטלין תלמוד תורה אם יש לו מתעסקין כדי קבורה. ונראה לר"י, דלענין מלאכה מבטלין כל בני העיר, ואסור אפילו למאן דלא קרי ולא תני, דלא מפליג מידי באלו מגלחין (מו"ק דף כז:) בהכי:
Tosafot on Ketubot 17b:1:1.english: "However, for one who taught, there is no measure" - In the She'iltot of Rav Aḥai it is written: And by implication we learn [that] for one who neither read [Scripture] nor studied [Mishnah], we do not interrupt [Torah study] if he has [enough] people attending to [him] as needed for burial. And it appears to the Ri that with respect to work, all the townspeople cease [working], and it is forbidden even for one who neither read nor studied, since [the Gemara] makes no distinction at all in [the chapter] Eilu Megalchin (Mo'ed Katan 27b) regarding this.

Tosafot on Ketubot 17b:4:1.hebrew: אלמנה מאי - ביהודה בעי, שלא היה אלא חילוק קליות; לכך בעי: "אלמנה מאי"? והלא פעמים אפילו בלא חופה היו רגילין לחלוק, ויש לחוש שמא חילקו בחופת אלמנה? ומשני: "לית לה כיסני". פירוש: היו נזהרין הרבה שלא יחלקו קליות בחופת אלמנה:
Tosafot on Ketubot 17b:4:1.english: What about a widow? - [The Gemara] asks [this] regarding Judea, where there was only the distribution of roasted grain; therefore it asks: "What about a widow?" For sometimes they were accustomed to distribute [roasted grain] even without a chuppah, and is there [not reason] to be concerned lest they distributed [it] at a widow's chuppah? And [the Gemara] answers: "She does not have kisanei." Explanation: they were very careful not to distribute roasted grain at a widow's chuppah.

Tosafot on Ketubot 17b:5:1.hebrew: וליתני מודה רבי יהושע שדה זו שלך היתה - דהוי רבותא טפי, דהוי ברי וברי:
Tosafot on Ketubot 17b:5:1.english: "And let [the Mishnah] teach: Rabbi Yehoshua concedes [in the case of] 'this field belonged to you'" - for it would be a greater novelty, since it is [a case of] certainty versus certainty.

Tosafot on Ketubot 17b:9:1.hebrew: ואחת בחיי הבן - ודווקא שהוא קטן, כפי' הקונט', אבל אם הוא גדול הוי חזקה, כדאמרי' בחזקת הבתים (ב"ב דף מב. ושם): "אכלה בפני האב שנה, ובפני הבן שנה, ובפני לוקח שנה — הרי זו חזקה". ורבינו שמואל פי' אהא דאמר בסמוך "ואפילו הגדיל" — אפילו הגדיל בחיי האב, דגדול לגבי מילי דאבוה קטן הוא. ואור"ת, דלפירושו הא דאמר בחזקת הבתים (ג"ז שם) דהויא חזקה בפני הבן, היינו כשהיה גדול בתחילת חזקה:
Tosafot on Ketubot 17b:9:1.english: And one [year] during the lifetime of the son - And [this applies] specifically when he is a minor, as Rashi explained, but if he is an adult, it is [a valid] presumptive ownership, as we say in [the chapter] Chezkat HaBatim (Bava Batra 42a, and there): "If he consumed [its produce] in the presence of the father [for] one year, and in the presence of the son [for] one year, and in the presence of a buyer [for] one year — behold, this is [a valid] presumptive ownership." And Rabbeinu Shmuel explained regarding that which [the Gemara] says nearby, "and even if he reached majority" — [that this means] even if he reached majority during the lifetime of the father, for an adult is considered a minor with respect to his father's affairs. And Rabbeinu Tam says that according to his explanation, that which [the Gemara] says in Chezkat HaBatim (ibid.) that it is [a valid] presumptive ownership in the presence of the son, that is when he was an adult at the beginning of the presumptive ownership.
